body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/tickets/test/directory.test.mjs`, `packages/tickets/test/manifest-rails.test.mjs`, `packages/tickets/test/pointer-bounded.test.mjs`, and `packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs` manually invoke `mkdtempSync` and guard removals in 25 `try/finally` blocks (plus several fixture leaks in pointer-bounded and pointer tests), and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/tickets/test/directory.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter from `test(...)`.
   - Replace `const root = () => mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'adlc-tickets-directory-'))` with `tmp(t, 'adlc-tickets-directory-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
2. In `packages/tickets/test/manifest-rails.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), ...))` with `tmp(t, ...)`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(root, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
3. In `packages/tickets/test/pointer-bounded.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace uncleaned `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), ...))` calls with `tmp(t, ...)`.
4. In `packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update `fixture(t, prefix = 'adlc-pointer-')` to accept `t` and create `root` via `tmp(t, prefix)`. Remove the `cleanup` callback property from the returned object.
   - Update test cases calling `fixture` to accept `t` parameter and pass `t` to `fixture(t, ...)`.
   - Remove all 17 `try { ... } finally { f.cleanup(); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Replace leaking `root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'adlc-pointer-uninit-'))` with `tmp(t, 'adlc-pointer-uninit-')`.
5. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/tickets/test/directory.test.mjs'`, `'packages/tickets/test/manifest-rails.test.mjs'`, `'packages/tickets/test/pointer-bounded.test.mjs'`, and `'packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set. (This removes the last remaining files from packages/tickets in ALLOWLIST).
6. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/tickets` exits 0 with all 379 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/tickets/test/directory.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/manifest-rails.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/tickets/test/directory.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/manifest-rails.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs` reports 0, 0, 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'f.cleanup()' packages/tickets/test/pointer.test.mjs` reports 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/tickets/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/tickets` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(tickets): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 25 try/finally blocks and fixture leaks across tickets tests
